original_text:
Powerful Without Being Complicated. Google Photos is simply a much more efficient and capable photo-management app than Apple Photos for the way I use it. The tools for organizing, sorting, searching, purging, and deleting photos make managing a large photo library considerably easier and faster.

What stands out most is how intuitive it remains. At a time when many apps seem to become less intuitive as more features are added, Google Photos manages to offer broader functionality without making basic tasks unnecessarily complicated.

Powerful, practical, easy to navigate, and genuinely useful. Five stars.
